# 二、代码
## 单例模式(ES6)
```typescript
class Window {
  private static instance: Window;
  private constructor() {}
  static getInstance() {
    if(!Window.instance) {
      Window.instance = new Window();
    }
    return Window.instance;
  }
}

const w1 = Window.getInstance();
const w2 = Window.getInstance();

console.log(w1 == w2);
```

## 单例模式(ES5)
```typescript
function Window() {}
Window.prototype.hello = function() {
  console.log('hello');
}

Window.getInstance = (function() {
  let window: Window;
  return function() {
    if(!window) {
      window = new (Window as any)();
    }
    return window;
  }
})();

// 缺点：就是必须要告诉使用者通过 getInstance 方法获取单例
const w1 = Window.getInstance();
const w2 = Window.getInstance();
console.log(w1 == w2);
```

## 透明单例
```typescript
/**
 * 透明单例模式
 *  客户端或者说使用者不需要知道要按单例使用
 */
const Window = (function() {
  let window: Window;
  const Window = function(this: Window) {
    if(window) {
      return w1;
    } else {
      return (window = this);
    }
  }
  return Window;
})();

const w1 = new (Window as any)();
const w2 = new (Window as any)();
console.log(w1 == w2);
```

## 单例与构建分离
```typescript
/**
 * 单例与构造过程的分离
 */
function Window() {}
Window.prototype.hello = function() {
  console.log('hello');
}

const createInstance = (function() {
  let instance: Window;
  return function() {
    if(!instance) {
      instance = new (Window as any)();
    }
    return instance;
  }
})();

// 缺点：就是必须要告诉使用者通过 getInstance 方法获取单例
const w1 = createInstance();
const w2 = createInstance();
console.log(w1 == w2);
```

## 封装变化
```typescript
/**
 * 封装变化
 */
function Window() {}
Window.prototype.hello = function() {
  console.log('hello');
}

// createInstance 可以创建任何类型的实例
const createInstance = function(Constructor: any) {
  let instance: any;
  return function(this: any) {
    if(!instance) {
      Constructor.apply(this, arguments); // 相当于调用构造函数
      Object.setPrototypeOf(this, Constructor.prototype); // 指定原型，相当于 this.__proto__ = Constructor.prototype
      instance = this;
    }
    return instance;
  }
};

const CreateWindow: any = createInstance(Window);
const w1 = new CreateWindow();
const w2 = new CreateWindow();
console.log(w1 == w2);
```

# 三、场景
## commonjs
```typescript
(function(modules: any) {
  // webpack的启动函数
  // 模块的缓存
  let installedModules: Record<string, any> = {};
  // 定义在浏览器中使用的require方法
  function __webpack_require__(moduleId: any) {
    // 检查模块是否在缓存
    if(installedModules[moduleId]) {
      return installedModules[moduleId].exports;
    }
    const module:Record<string, any> = (installedModules[moduleId] = {
      i: moduleId,
      l: false,
      exports: {}
    });

    // 执行模块函数
    modules[moduleId].call(
      module.exports,
      module,
      module.exports,
      __webpack_require__
    );

    // 把模块设置为已加载
    module.l = true;

    // 返回模块的导出对象
    return module.exports;
  }
  // __webpack_require__('./src/index.js');
})({
  './src/index.js': function(module:any, exports: any) {
    console.log(module, exports)
  }
});
```

## 模态窗口
## store
```typescript
function createStore(reducer: any) {
  let state: any;
  let listeners: any[] = [];
  function getState() {
    return state;
  }
  function dispatch(action: any) {
    state.reducer(state, action);
    listeners.forEach(l => l());
  }
  function subscribe(listener: any) {
    listeners.push(listener);
    return () => {
      listeners = listeners.filter(item => item != listener);
    }
  }
  // dispatch({});
  return {
    getState,
    dispatch,
    subscribe
  }
}
// redux应用中，只会有一个仓库，它是单例的
const store = createStore((state: any, action: any) => state);
console.log(store);
```

## express
```typescript
const express = require('express');
const fs = require('fs');
// 缓存一定要做成单例
const cache: Map<string, any> = new Map();
const app = express();

app.get('/user/:id', (req: any, res: any) => {
  const id = req.params.id;
  const user = cache.get(id);;
  if(user) {
    res.json(user);
  } else {
    fs.readFile(`./users/${id}.json`, 'utf8', (error: any, data: any) => {
      console.log(error, data)
      const user = JSON.parse(data);
      cache.set(id, user);
      res.json(user);
    })
  }
});

app.listen(8088);
```
